cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem tohoto předmětu je představit jazyk Java jako moderní objektově orientovaný programovací jazyk, který nabízí široké možnosti využití. Po úspěšném absolvování předmětu by měl student být schopen aplikovat objektově orientovaný přístup v programování desktopových aplikací. Zvládnutí problematiky je předpokladem studia volitelného předmětu Java aplikace.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of this course is to introduce Java language as a modern object orientated programming language offering wide area of utilization. Upon successful completion of this course the student will be expected to be able to apply object-oriented paradigm to the programming of desktop applications. Successful completion of this course is a precondition for elective course Java applications.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Features and utilization of Java language (allowance 2/2) a.Features of Java languageb.Application creation and distributionc.Java platforms2.Object-oriented programming (OOP) in Java (allowance 8/8) a.Classes, interfaces, packages, access controlb.Object creation and removalc.Data types (primitive types and object types), arrays, containers, generic types in classes and methodsd.Iterators, operators and precedence, statements, control flow statements, exceptions.3.Input/output operations in Java (allowance 4/4) a.Data streamsb.Working with filesc.Data serialization and deserialization4.Code conventions for Java, rules of application development (allowance 3/3) a.Using JavaDoc for documentation generationb.Packages and JAR archivesc.Test-driven development (TDD), JUnit testing framework5.Threads (allowance 3/3) a.Multi-threaded applicationsb.Synchronizationc.Thread priority6.Java Network Programming (allowance 2/2) a.IP Network Address Representationb.Sending and receiving UDP datagramsc.Sending and receiving IP packets using TCP. Implementation of TCP client, TCP server, HTTP client7.Functional interfaces, lambda expressions, predicates, data streams (allowance 6/6) a.Functional interfacesb.Lambda expressionsc.Predicatesd.Data streams
